title: doronicum grandiflorum var. viscosum
intro:
Doronicum grandiflorum var. viscosum, commonly known as Sticky Leopard's Bane, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its yellow or orange flowers and sticky stems.

This plant is used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Doronicum grandiflorum var. viscosum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
